items.description: Each party must pay its own corporate income, franchise, and other net-income-based taxes imposed on it by any governmental authority.
items.span_text: Each party shall be solely responsible for the payment of all corporate income taxes, franchise taxes, and any other taxes measured by or based on net income that are imposed on it by any governmental authority.

items.description: The parties must cooperate to minimize tax withholding where legally permissible, including by providing necessary documentation.
items.span_text: The parties agree to cooperate to minimize the withholding of taxes where legally permissible, including by providing any necessary documentation (e.g., tax residency certificates).

items.description: If a withholding tax applies, the parties must negotiate in good faith on how it will be addressed between them.
items.span_text: If the parties determine that a withholding tax applies to any of the transactions contemplated in this agreement, the parties agree to negotiate in good faith as to how such withholding taxes will be addressed between the parties.
items.trigger: If the parties determine that a withholding tax applies to any of the transactions contemplated in this agreement

items.description: The receiving party must pay any applicable VAT, sales, GST or similar consumption taxes, which are added to the agreed fees, unless the pricing section says otherwise.
items.span_text: Any value-added tax (VAT), sales tax, goods and services tax (GST), or similar consumption taxes, if applicable, shall be added to the agreed-upon fees and paid by the receiving party, unless otherwise specified in the agreement's pricing section.

items.description: The paying party must provide a valid tax invoice meeting all legal requirements.
items.span_text: The paying party will provide a valid tax invoice that meets all legal requirements.
